num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of vehicles available in the fleet.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand that a single vehicle can carry on one route.
planning_horizon: <int> Latest time by which all vehicles must return to the depot.
service_time: <int> Time required to complete service at each customer location.

depot.id: <int> Location index of the depot at the start of each route.
depot.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest times at which vehicles may depart from and return to the depot.
depot.demand: <int> Demand at the depot, always zero.

depot_end.id: <int> Location index of the depot at the end of each route.
depot_end.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the return depot.
depot_end.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the return depot.
depot_end.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest times at which vehicles may arrive back at the depot.
depot_end.demand: <int> Demand at the return depot, always zero.

customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods requested by the customer.
customers.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest allowable times at which service may begin at this customer.
customers.service_time: <int> Time required to complete service at this customer.
customers.preferred_time: <float> Preferred service start time for this customer, equal to the midpoint of the time window.
customers.inconvenience_cost_at_preferred_time: <float> Inconvenience cost when service begins at the preferred time, always zero.

distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers+2][num_customers+2]> Travel time and routing cost between each pair of locations, indexed as depot (0), customers (1 to num_customers), and return depot (num_customers+1).

inconvenience_cost_function.type: <str> Type of the inconvenience cost function applied to each customer.
inconvenience_cost_function.formula: <str> Mathematical expression for the inconvenience cost as a function of service start time.
inconvenience_cost_function.rho: <float> Scaling factor that controls how steeply inconvenience cost increases as service deviates from the preferred time.
